name: navigation
description: Top-of-page primary navigation with hover-to-open mega-menu dropdowns. For the Tracy Harris Co main site.
intent: Give visitors one clear way to find every product, resource, and page on the site. Signal brand at a glance. Make the primary call-to-action (Apply) the visual anchor.
whenToUse: Every page on tracyharris.co root and parent brand sections. Product-specific funnel pages use a simpler, stripped-back version.

logo.description: Brand logo, top-left. SVG. 30px height default.

navItems.description: Array of nav items. Each item is either a direct link or a dropdown with sub-items grouped by title.

primaryCta.description: Call-to-action on the right. For Tracy Harris Co main nav, this is 'Apply' (leads to FFB application). Stands out with filled accent.

navItemShape.label: string (Programs, Podcast, etc.)
navItemShape.href: string (optional — if no subMenus, behaves as direct link)

items.label: string (e.g. FFB)
items.icon: string (SVG path name or inline SVG)

interactions.desktop: Hover on nav item opens dropdown. Mouse off closes. Click pill anywhere to keep open.
interactions.mobile: Dropdowns don't exist on mobile. Hamburger opens full-screen menu that lists all items flat. Use disclosure pattern.

avoid: More than 5 top-level nav items. If you have more, group them under dropdowns.
Three levels of nesting. Max two: top-level → dropdown group → item.
Icons that don't match brand style. Tracy/FFB/FFM use outline line icons. FRESH uses filled pillar dots.

a11y.keyboard: Tab to focus nav item, Enter/Space to open dropdown, Escape to close, Arrow keys to move between sub-items.
a11y.contrast: Nav text must hit 4.5:1 against canvas. Hover states also.
